# TDPdf v1.23.5.0

**Fixes Close Without Saving appearing to hang and TDPdf continuing to use substantial CPU.**

Closing or switching away from a document now cancels every page-rendering pipeline, including grid and continuous-view background work. TDPdf previously canceled only the primary-page render and then forced a blocking full memory collection while other PDFium workers could still be rasterizing pages.

Released bitmap memory is now collected later without blocking the interface. Application exit also places a firm two-second bound on OpenTelemetry exporter shutdown.

The unsaved-changes prompt now uses explicit **Close Without Saving** and **Cancel** buttons instead of ambiguous **Yes** and **No** labels.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.23.5.0, so managed machines pick this up on the next evaluation. Assignments are unaffected.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to confirm the download independently.
